item.title: Suoming Daoshu - Beide de Yuwang Qingdan
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Secret Garden
  • 発売日: 2024-04-09
  • スコア: 5.41/10 (15 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 索命倒數-背德的欲望清單
  • 英語名: Inochi no Countdown ~ Haitokusha no Yokubou List

あらすじ

A mysterious virus attacked the entire city…

All the law enforcement officials suddenly disappeared, and the order of the city quickly collapsed…

The city had become a checklist with all the words of desire written on it…

The ugliness of the human nature was impacting my sanity. Under the chaos, women had become toys

item.title: Mu Niang Tiaojiao
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Secret Garden
  • 発売日: 2022-12-06
  • スコア: 5.2299999999999995/10 (25 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 母娘調教
  • 英語名: Hitozuma Conditioning

别名

  • 人妻コンディショニング

あらすじ

I was worried about not being able to pay rent to the landlord when I inadvertently rescued the landlord’s wife, Sophia.“I-I’m sorry, I… I didn’t mean to cause you any trouble…” Sophia sobbed timidly.

“What do you want?” The landlord glanced at you condescendingly.

Your acts of kindness were rewarded not with gratitude but with the contempt of those who thought they were higher in status.
